tasks.label: git-commit
tasks.command:
git commit -m "feat: agent swarm with loop hardening and markup defense (v3.9.0)

- Convert agent pipeline to full agent swarm: parallel research agents,
  pre-implementation review, and self-correcting implementation agent
- Windowed spin guard: suppresses exact repeats (A,A,A) and oscillation
  (A,B,A,B) while allowing legitimate re-reads after edits
- Deadline nudge: forces runTests call when 2 turns remain without tests
- Safety-net test run: pipeline runs runTests itself if turn cap is hit
  without tests, so reports always carry a real verdict
- Tool-call markup defense: strips text markup written by models instead
  of real tool calls, nudges model to conclude with plain text
- Rename chat participant to Agent Swarm (@swarm)
- Context overflow retry, rate-limit fix, cost tracker
- 146 tests passing across 21 test files
- README redesign with Mermaid architecture diagrams
- CHANGELOG and docs updated"
